name: s8-resp-repl
config:
[runtime]
mode = "accept_edits"
[[permissions]]
tool = "apply_patch"
pattern = "*"
decision = "allow"
[[permissions]]
tool = "run_command"
pattern = "python -m pytest*"
decision = "allow"

runs.stdin:
Fix the failing test and verify the fix.
/diff
/compact
Add a one-line usage example to the docstring of multiply in src/calc.py.
/undo
y
/status
/exit
